summary_en: 1,108,400 ordinary shares cancelled. Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury): 25,966,328. Effective date 2026-06-30.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: GIKEN LTD. completed cancellation of 1,108,400 ordinary shares on 2026-06-30, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation was decided by the Board of Directors on 2025-10-10. Following the cancellation, issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury) total 25,966,328 shares. The cancelled shares represented approximately 4.1% of shares outstanding (1,108,400 ÷ 27,074,728 ex-treasury pre-cancellation).
